recognize_zh: 低倍下可見一個大而邊界模糊的淡染結節，內部因散在較大細胞與組織球而呈斑駁外觀，周圍為深藍色密集小淋巴球，整體結構消失，符合 NLPHL 的大型模糊結節型態。
features: Large, ill-defined pale nodule with a mottled (moth-eaten) appearance in the center of the field
Mottling due to scattered larger pale cells and histiocytes among small lymphocytes
Surrounding zones of densely packed dark small lymphocytes blending with the nodule edge
Effaced architecture with scattered small vessels at the periphery; no broad sclerosis
Cytologic detail not assessable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymph node shows effaced architecture with a large, ill-defined, pale nodule showing a mottled appearance, surrounded by dense sheets of small dark lymphocytes that blend with its edges. Scattered small vessels are present, and there is no broad sclerosis or necrosis. Cytologic features of the larger cells within the nodule cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma; high-power evaluation for LP cells and immunostains (CD20, CD3, PD-1, CD21) are needed to confirm the diagnosis and characterize the architectural pattern.

ddx.vs: PTGC nodules are usually few, within a node with preserved reactive follicles, and lack LP cells.
Follicular lymphoma shows many uniform crowded follicles of BCL2+ neoplastic follicle center cells rather than a single large mottled nodule.
The low-power pattern can be identical, and the distinction requires CD30/CD15 versus CD20/OCT2 staining of the large cells.
Toxoplasmosis shows florid reactive follicles with epithelioid histiocyte clusters and monocytoid B-cell zones while preserving nodal architecture.
